checks.name: single-touch jump and flip
checks.evidence: touch-ready.png shows the embedded starting knife; touch-100ms.png shows the same knife displaced forward/upward and rotated near horizontal after one native touch; touch-600ms.png shows continued forward travel and descent.

checks.name: landing and next-action state
checks.evidence: touch-1300ms.png and retry-01.png show the knife settled flat on the white track after the jump; a later touch launches it again. No separate landed UI is shown.

checks.name: ordinary cuttable objects
checks.evidence: Direct play visibly cut green/red apples, yellow citrus/lemon-like fruit, cheese, and coconut. retry-02.png through retry-06.png show the sequence and fragments falling off the track.

checks.name: continuous cutting feedback and cash
checks.evidence: retry-02.png shows separated apple pieces with floating +$1; retry-05.png shows coconut-related +$5; gap-after.png shows several colored cylinders scattered with stacked +$1 feedback. A persistent cash total was not visible in the observed segment.

checks.name: gap flight and timing pressure
checks.evidence: gap-edge.png visibly instructs KEEP TAPPING TO FLY. retry-09.png followed by retry-10.png records low-frequency tapping falling into grass and returning to the start; gap-rapid-2.png through gap-rapid-10.png show rapid touches adding successive aerial arcs and crossing the gap.

checks.name: special level objects
checks.evidence: gap-after.png shows racks of colored cylindrical bars breaking apart; post-gap-02.png shows a bright pink spike pad with a BEWARE OF SPIKES warning and visible watermelon/coconut/small fruit beyond it.

checks.name: failure and retry
checks.evidence: Low-frequency gap play visibly put the knife on the grass in retry-09.png; retry-10.png immediately shows the original start/tutorial again. No explicit failure dialog or manual restart button was observed.

checks.name: three ordinary levels
checks.evidence: Only the first ordinary level and repeated restarts of that level were directly observed; no level completion or two additional ordinary levels were reached.

checks.name: finish multiplier
checks.evidence: No finish multiplier zones or multiplier result were directly reached in the successful black-box sessions.

checks.name: reward or hidden-coin level
checks.evidence: No reward/hidden-coin trigger, bonus layout, payout, or bonus failure rule was directly reached.

checks.name: knife unlock affects ability
checks.evidence: No knife unlock screen or alternate knife was directly reached, so cosmetic versus mechanical effects could not be determined.

checks.name: non-cuttable, break-knife, and spike outcomes
checks.evidence: A spike pad and warning were directly visible, and the later sequence restarted, but the exact collision frame was not captured. No distinct break-knife object or complete non-cuttable taxonomy was directly observed.

issues.message: Only the first ordinary level was directly playable to the observed spike section; three-level comparison was not completed.
issues.evidence: Successful sessions repeatedly returned to the first tutorial after gap or spike-section failure.

issues.message: Finish multipliers and reward/hidden-coin levels were not directly observed.
issues.evidence: The black-box sessions did not reach the first finish; no multiplier or bonus-level screenshot exists.

issues.message: Knife unlock effects and break-knife rules remain unverified.
issues.evidence: No unlock screen, alternate knife, or explicit broken-knife state appeared during direct play.

issues.message: The public embedded game was intermittent under automated Chromium.
issues.evidence: Some fresh attempts remained on a dark game surface after activation, and one navigation failed with ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED; successful attempts are represented by the listed screenshots.
